patch.value: Reproduced with an isolated HASSIO_CONFIG directory and token supplied only through the environment. The wizard successfully wrote 0600 settings/auth files but stdout began with SETUP WIZARD before the requested JSON payload. Fix the non-interactive path to emit one formatter-validated receipt, represent connection-test success/failure in that receipt, keep errors actionable, and preserve the interactive guided experience.
Non-interactive setup wizard corrupts structured stdout

The settings wizard writes human banners, progress lines, and prose around formatter-selected output, so --format json or json-compact cannot be parsed and other advertised formats are not honored as single programmatic receipts.

Every non-interactive formatter emits one valid parseable receipt without human prefix/suffix lines; Connection success and failure are represented in the receipt without token, raw URL, location name, or other private values; Interactive wizard guidance remains intuitive and isolated config/auth/data files retain secure permissions
Isolated reproduction completed against live Core 2026.7.4; current wizard implementation and tests inspected; formatter utilities available
CI and agents can configure hassio without brittle stdout scraping.
Removes a hard parser failure from the mandatory setup path and prevents accidental private-value logging.
One deterministic setup receipt across all six supported formats with regression tests and live isolated acceptance.
The user explicitly requires a fully working setup wizard and valid programmatic output; current behavior fails strict JSON parsing.
homeassistant-cli 2026.8.6, Bun, non-interactive wizard, isolated HASSIO_CONFIG, live Home Assistant Core 2026.7.4
Run hassio settings wizard --non-interactive with isolated HASSIO_CONFIG, environment token, valid URL, --config-read-only true, and --format json-compact; parse stdout with JSON.parse.
stdout is exactly one valid JSON object describing saved paths, read-only mode, and connection outcome without secrets.
stdout begins with a SETUP WIZARD banner and multiple human lines, causing JSON.parse to throw before any receipt can be consumed.
Automated bootstrap and agent workflows cannot safely consume the advertised structured format.
